repeatAccessCountingNotes.unit: For each path, visits after its first content/diff/search-hit access count as repeat accesses. 175 visits minus 106 distinct paths equals 69.
repeatAccessCountingNotes.necessaryDifferentFragments: Different required fragments, diff versus original, and targeted locating searches can revisit the same file; all count. The 69 count does not distinguish them.
